51522188.DESCRIPTION: Competitive inhibition of HIS-FLAG-tagged recombinant Leishmania infantum TryR expressed in Escherichia coli assessed as dissociation constant by SPR assay
51522188.references_previous: M. A. Toro, P. A. Sanchez-Murcia, D. Moreno, M. Ruiz-Santacruz, J. F. Alzate, A. Negri, M. J. Camarasa, F. Gago, S. Velazquez, A. Jimenez-Ruiz, Probing the dimerization interface of Leishmania infantum trypanothione reductase with site-directed mutagenesis and short peptides, ChemBioChem 14 (2013) 1212–1217.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare, Chicago, IL, USA) using a CM5 sensor chip. The immobilization of the HIS-FLAG-tagged recombinant Leishmania infantum TryR was performed as described previously [25]. Briefly, 10 μg/mL of the protein in 10 mM sodium acetate, pH 4.0, was captured on a streptavidin-coated surface using a biotinylated anti-FLAG M2 antibody (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA). The surface was blocked with 1 M ethanolamine, pH 8.5, for 10 min. The binding of the inhibitors was assessed in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4) at 25 °C. The inhibitors were injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM for 120 s, followed by a 300 s dissociation phase. The sensorgrams were double-referenced by subtracting the signal from a blank flow cell and the signal from a control injection of buffer. The data were analyzed using the Biacore T200 Evaluation Software (GE Healthcare). The dissociation constants (Kd) were calculated by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Fig. 2. Competitive inhibition of LiTryR by the triazolium salt 4a. (A) Plot of the initial velocities (v) as a function of oxidized trypanothione disulfide (TS2) at seven different concentrations of compound 4a. 2-nitro-5-thiobenzoic acid (TNB) production was monitored by the absorbance at 412 nm. Curves were fitted using Equation 1. (B) Double-reciprocal plot. Data are from results obtained in a representative assay from three independent experiments.
